headline_claim: Separate component evaluations show that coordinate-invariant analytic garment semantics are learnable from complete vector patterns, improve compatible primitive-cycle candidate coverage in visual-to-DSL retrieval, transfer to a distinct 128-query four-view student, and support small validation-gated BasicBlock edits. These parser/retrieval and student/editor lanes use different ontologies and checkpoints and are not yet an integrated end-to-end generator; target-topology top-1 selection and causal drafting-parameter inversion remain unsolved.

component_contract.implemented_a: A canonical 0.95M Pattern DSL parser on 1,983 vector patterns plus a separate visual-to-DSL retrieval bridge on the 1,962 exact-pattern/four-view intersection. It retrieves existing train-bank programs and applies symbolic role-cycle projection; it does not generate new commands or feed the guarded BasicBlock editor.
component_contract.implemented_b: A separate 3.23M 128-query vector-graph teacher and 3.62M four-view student trained from 1,536 provisional BasicBlocks plus the 517-record GCD strict-common subset, followed by validation-gated editing of a deterministic category-default BasicBlock. Its ontology is panel/path/landmark/reference-line and excludes seam queries.
not_integrated: canonical DSL parser as the direct teacher of the 128-query student
retrieved DSL anchor into the guarded BasicBlock editor
raw ReWeaver output into the parser-verifier-editor bridge
bridge output into simulation or expert A/B evaluation
component_contract.future_only: Target-conditioned topology generation, missing-panel and edge split/merge commands, parametric drafting, a general seam length/direction/ease solver, and simulation/expert validation.

four_view_to_shared_semantic_space.warning: The presence label distribution is highly positive; coordinate error is the primary transfer metric.

symbolic_candidate_reranking_negative_co.interpretation: The semantic layer verifies and repairs internal program consistency, but current anchor-side semantics do not tell which valid topology matches the target image.

fixed_split_raw_fpn_vs_dsl_retrieval.warning: The raw FPN baseline is parameter-free while the DSL dual encoder is trained; this is fixed-split evidence for a better candidate beam, not an architecture-matched semantic-pretraining ablation or a consistent per-category top-1 win.

strict_tshirt_surface_correspondence_pro.superseded_reason: The surface builder bypassed the existing common-basic role resolver; 75 front-shoulder edges were stale-labeled side_seam even though their exact geometry and shoulder stitch mates existed.
strict_tshirt_surface_correspondence_pro.interpretation: The corrected 61-sample model learns element localization beyond the mean-pattern prior, but absolute drafting-parameter regression remains close to a mean predictor and is observational rather than causal.

portfolio_claim_boundary: The semantic parser is evaluated on GCDv2-internal derived labels, not expert-approved industrial pattern semantics.
The visual tests are sample-ID unseen but same-generator, same-render-style, and fixed-neutral-body evaluations.
The result does not establish superiority over ReWeaver, Garment Particles, or another end-to-end image-to-pattern model.
The reranking ablation is a negative result: semantic projection removes grammar violations but does not improve exact target-topology top-1.
The guarded editor preserves an existing topology and cannot generate missing panels or repair a topology family mismatch.
The fixed-split raw-FPN comparison uses a parameter-free baseline against a trained DSL dual encoder; it supports candidate-beam coverage, not a fully architecture-matched ablation.
Public display and redistribution rights for source dataset images remain separate from technical benchmark results.
